collections.prompt:
Commercial apparel photograph, square 1:1: shot 2 of a 3-image product-page set for the LSU TIGERS Tie-Dye all-over-print cuffed shorts.

PRODUCT LOCK:
Attach image 1 of this set (the prompt 1 output). The shorts here are the IDENTICAL shorts from image 1: same cut, wide rolled cuffs, two gold waist buttons, same print, every motif in the same place and size. Do not redesign, recolour, add or remove any motif. Build this image from image 1 directly, never from another generated image of the set.

PRINT MAP (positions only, copied from image 1): the purple, gold and white spiral tie-dye centred on the right leg and running over both cuffs; the logo on the left hip; the figure at the centre of the spiral on the right leg.

SHOT ROLE - PRINT DETAIL:
Top-down flat lay on a cream linen sheet: the shorts laid flat with one cuff unrolled halfway to show the print continuing on the turned-up fabric; close enough that the print edges, the logo and the figure are sharp and visibly flat-printed into the fabric; a gift box half in frame at the top, its lid printed with one line that reads exactly: LSU TIGERS.

LIGHT:
One light source: soft window light from the top left.

KEEP:
Every printed word spelled exactly as listed.
